exposure: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) grade 3 (with varying prenatal suspicion rates)
Management strategies for PAS grade 3 (conservative management attempts, immediate and secondary hysterectomy rates)
Country/study period (UK: May 2010-April 2011, France: November 2013-October 2015, Italy: September 2014-August 2016)
outcome: Severe maternal complications (death, damage to bowel or urinary tract)
cohort: The participants were 124 women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) grade 3, including 39 from the UK, 51 from France, and 34 from Italy.
finding: Maternal outcomes, including postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion, and hysterectomy rates, for women with grade 3 placenta accreta spectrum varied significantly between the three study countries and periods, correlating with differences in prenatal screening and peri-operative management.
